# 3ngram v1.9.0

Minor: the 25 October 2026 memory-harness audit follow-ups. Commitments
carry deadlines, owners and the reason they were settled; reads label
filing, account and session provenance; proposal review pages completely;
writes can follow an account-level scope policy; and `revise` can archive or
reaffirm stale memories without writing a successor.

## Changes

### Writes

- **Commitment deadline and owner on native `remember`** (#323, resolves
  #165). A `commitment` write over MCP, REST, the SDK or the CLI
  (`--due`, `--owner`) accepts an optional `dueAt` (ISO-8601 UTC instant, at
  most millisecond precision) and `owner`. Both land on the auto-created
  commitment row, so briefing reports it overdue and the surfacing sweep
  expires it exactly as for imported commitments. Either field on a
  non-commitment is rejected, and nothing is inferred from content.
- **Write-scope policy** (#336, resolves #235). `configure_scope` gains
  `set_write_default` (`off` | `default` | `require`), the write-side twin of
  `set_retrieval_default`. `off` is the default, so nothing changes until an
  account opts in. An explicit `scope` always wins; `remember` echoes the
  scope it actually wrote to; `describe_environment` reports
  `writeScopePolicy`.
- **Resolve reason** (#338, resolves #234). `resolve` takes an optional
  `reason` (trimmed, 1–500 characters), stored on the commitment row
  (`commitments.last_resolution_reason`), never in the append-only event
  payload. A later reasonless transition clears it. A blocker resolve with a
  reason is rejected. It is read back only through
  `GET /api/v1/memories/:id/history` (`lastResolutionReason`) and the owner's
  export, is never logged, and is nulled by account erasure.
- **`revise` archive disposition** (#339, resolves #217).
  `{ kind: "archive", memoryIds }` moves 1–50 memories `active → archived`
  with no successor or edge, content and dates untouched, one outcome per id
  (`archived`, `already_archived`, or `rejected` with `not_found`,
  `superseded`, `open_commitment` or `blocker`). Each archive writes an
  `archive` event `{ disposition: "archive", sessionRunId? }`; the REST
  archive route writes the same payload and now takes the account guard.
  AGENTS.md hard rule 1 names the audited `active → archived` transition.
- **`revise` reaffirm disposition** (#340, resolves #218).
  `{ kind: "reaffirm", memoryIds }` records "reviewed, still valid": it
  stamps `memories.last_reviewed_at` and writes a new `reaffirm` event kind,
  with no new row, edge, status or `updated_at` change. Briefing stale
  candidates key on `GREATEST(updated_at, last_reviewed_at)`, so a
  reaffirmed memory leaves that section for one full window; never-reviewed
  memories are judged as before.

### Reads

- **Search hit metadata** (#324, resolves #319). Hits carry `scope`,
  nullable `project` and, for commitments, `commitmentStatus`, on both MCP
  projections, REST and the SDK; the CLI labels them. Ordering and cursors
  are unchanged.
- **Briefing commitment owner and filing** (#325, resolves #261). Commitment
  items carry `owner` (never inferred), `scope` and `project`.
- **History source session** (#326, resolves #262). The history read adds
  allowlisted `sessionRunId` per event and `createdBySessionRunId` on the
  envelope, re-parsed through the provenance schema, `null` when absent.
- **Complete proposal review** (#334, resolves #320). `review_proposals` and
  `GET /api/v1/proposals` take an opaque `cursor` and return `hasMore`,
  `nextCursor` and live `totals`; the MCP list walks edge and fact proposals
  as one merged stream, so `limit` now bounds a page across both kinds.
  `count` keeps its meaning (edge proposals on this page).
- **Account identity and facets** (#335, resolves #321 and #168).
  `describe_environment` reports `account: { id }` (the same id as
  `GET /api/v1/me`, never derived from a scope name) and inlines the live
  scope/project inventory as `facets` (capped at 50 per array, with
  `truncated` flags). New MCP resource `threengram://facets` returns the
  complete inventory.

### Session closure

- **Defensive triage finalize** (#337, resolves #189).
  `POST /api/v1/agent-sessions/triage/complete` accepts `defensive: true`:
  the attempt lands `expired` and the watermark stays at the begin stamp, so
  a write committed between begin and a complete whose debrief was never
  shown stays untriaged. The Stop hook (`cmd/3ngram-hook`, released by its
  own `3ngram-hook-v*` tag) sends it on arm-without-inject paths and falls
  back to the ordinary complete on a 400 from an older server.
- **Real-concurrency session tests** (#337, resolves #178), plus test-only
  hardening of the triage attempt log (#316, #307) and the US4 auth harness
  (#318, #297). The hook shows each precheck hit's real id (#317, #263; hook
  release).

## Compatibility

- **MCP output schemas grow** (`search`, `briefing`, `describe_environment`,
  `review_proposals`, `resolve`, `revise`); every addition is a new field or
  a new union branch, and output schemas advertise open, so clients on the
  previous catalog keep working. `revise`'s registered output is the new
  `reviseToolOutputV2Schema` union; `reviseToolOutputSchema` is unchanged.
- **REST**: a rejected id on the revise archive/reaffirm disposition is a
  `200` whose body carries `outcome: "rejected"`; read the outcome, not the
  status code. `GET /api/v1/proposals` pages; a caller that reads only the
  first page keeps today's behaviour.
- **SDK**: `revise()` is overloaded (disposition body → outcome list, other
  bodies → memory, the full `ReviseBody` union → `ReviseToolOutputV2`);
  `resolve()` takes `{ reason }`.
- **Native remember**: `scope` no longer defaults to `personal` in the schema
  (the server applies the account's write policy, `off` → `personal`).
- **New event kind `reaffirm`.** Consumers that switch exhaustively on
  `memory_events.event_kind` must handle it; it is importable.

## Operations

- **Migrations 0039–0041** (additive, run before starting the new server):
  `0039_user_write_scope_policy` (new table, RLS + FORCE RLS),
  `0040_commitment_resolution_reason` (nullable column + length CHECK on
  `commitments`), `0041_memory_last_reviewed_at` (nullable column on
  `memories`, `memory_events` kind CHECK regenerated to include
  `reaffirm`). No backfill.
- No configuration change. `SESSION_CLOSER_ENABLED` and
  `THREENGRAM_STOP_NUDGE` stay default-off.
